implementation: Independent native filename/TCC metadata policy, no copied legacy pixel implementation. Shared original crysirror-image RgbLookup owns all pixel transforms.

native_semantics.suffix: decimal effect >=10; table = effect/10-1; ?030 means index2, not a G00 pattern
native_semantics.source: configured #TONECURVE_FILENAME resolved case-insensitively under original dat directory
native_semantics.TCC: version1000 i32LE, count i32LE, RGB tables at0xFE8+i*0x340,768bytes per curve
native_semantics.scope: strict decimal suffix only; malformed or unsupported encodings fail, no effect stripping

shared_semantics.RgbLookup: red/green/blue each exactly256 u8; explicit profile straight_rgba
shared_semantics.alpha: preserved exactly, including hidden RGB transformed at alpha0
shared_semantics.premultiplied_rgba: recognized but rejected before job admission; ImageSurface/resources have no association metadata
shared_semantics.atomicity: immutable source; validation/cancellation failure yields no published result; ImageJob reserves worker and memory; owner publishes only Ready with matching client

native_boundaries.metadata: one bounded native TaskPool worker reads<=1MiB TCC and<=64MiB encoded source and validates<=4096 G00 regions; blake3 source identity passed to shared Asset ImageJob; first valid TCC byte snapshot is retained per client (<=1MiB) for subsequent variants
native_boundaries.pixels: shared ImageJob decodes and applies RGB LUT on CPU workers; alpha/atlas regions preserved
native_boundaries.publication: Core HostServices.publish_image_resource validates owner/layout/budgets and publishes unique immutable __image_resource path retaining RGBA Arc+worker resource lease; no owner PNG/scan/hash/copy. Native does not release a variant while live layers may reference it; cache is bounded.
native_boundaries.cache_limits: 32 variants and128MiB RGBA per native client
native_boundaries.PC: original object opcode remains pending; original obj::creation runs only after Ready; no object install or opcode ACK during dependency wait

game_behavior.bootstrap: normal installed-game detection/voice archive mounts; ordinary Ctrl and mouse down/up track
game_behavior.GPU: Apple M5 Metal, headless, no OS window/audio device
game_behavior.at10000: scene513:91, normal corridor narration, errornull, tone variants ready2/pendingfalse
game_behavior.at16000: scene513:203, normal cafeteria/Riki dialogue, Pause17, errornull, ready2/pendingfalse

remaining: No persisted publication identity or original/native/framework save support is claimed. Native checkpoint API remains Unsupported; runtime snapshot/restore explicitly rejects live image publications. Correct future save restore must reconstruct engine-owned resources from native names/table policy, not persist raw Arcs/ephemeral paths.
